name: Ducati 860 GT / 900 GTS
engine: 864 cc air-cooled bevel-drive V-twin, square cases
intro: The square-case touring bevel twins. Giugiaro styled the 860 GT.

H: The bevel-drive cams are set with shims and need patience. Check the bevel gear backlash and the desmo shims before you run it hard.
